9,899 reviews. And most tourists on the island still skip this place.

Phu Quoc Prison History Museum tells the story of a French colonial prison used to hold Vietnam War POWs. The mannequins inside demonstrate real torture methods used here. It is not comfortable. It is not supposed to be.

If you want to understand Phu Quoc beyond the beaches, this is where you start.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
